content.user_title: Draft HOA Notices, Minutes, and Annual Budgets
content.value_statement: HOA boards need consistent paperwork for meetings, budgets, enforcement, and dues collection. This guide helps Claude and Codex draft those documents for board and counsel review.
actual_capabilities: Draft board and annual member meeting notices, agendas, and minutes.
Structure annual budget worksheets with operating expenses, reserve contributions, and per-unit dues calculations.
Draft courtesy letters, formal violation notices, hearing notices, and fine assessments.
Draft dues collection letters through counsel referral for possible lien action.
Prepare annual meeting packages with proxy and ballot drafts.
Draft architectural review forms using supplied association requirements.
limitations: The guide covers US HOA practice; state laws and association governing documents require separate verification.
Outputs are working drafts, not legal advice or guaranteed compliance.
The folder excludes scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package.
The guide does not implement notice delivery, payment collection, or automated legal enforcement.

use_cases.title: Prepare a board meeting packet
use_cases.description: Draft a meeting notice, agenda, and minutes outline using supplied bylaws, meeting details, and verified notice requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan annual assessments
use_cases.description: Organize operating expenses, reserve contributions, and unit counts into a budget worksheet and proposed dues calculation.

use_cases.title: Document covenant enforcement
use_cases.description: Prepare a staged violation notice sequence based on documented facts and applicable provisions for association counsel review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a meeting agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a board meeting agenda for [association] on [date]. Use these topics: [topics]. Flag missing meeting details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: organize a routine board meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare meeting minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [meeting notes] into draft minutes for [association]. Include attendance, motions, vote tallies, and action items. Mark missing facts without inventing decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Build an annual budget worksheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a draft annual HOA budget using [operating expenses], [reserve contribution], [other income], and [unit count]. Show calculations and assumptions. Flag unequal assessment allocations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare financial materials for board review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a violation notice sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [state requirements], [governing provisions], and [documented violation facts], draft courtesy, formal, hearing, and fine notices. Flag unsupported deadlines. Mark every stage for counsel review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a staged enforcement packet without assuming legal authority.

output_examples.input: Draft budget totals for 40 equally assessed units, $100,000 operating expenses, $20,000 reserves, and no other income.
output: Draft annual budget: operating expenses $100,000; reserve contribution $20,000; total assessment funding $120,000.
Assumption: all 40 units share assessments equally; confirm governing documents and board approval requirements.

output_examples.input: Draft a courtesy letter about an unapproved fence. The governing provision and response deadline have not been supplied.
output: Draft courtesy letter: Dear [owner], the association has received a report of a fence installed without documented architectural approval.
Please provide any approval records or contact [association representative] to discuss the review process.
Before sending: verify the facts and insert the applicable governing provision.
No deadline or fine is stated because supporting authority was not supplied.

best_practices: Provide current state requirements, governing documents, and verified facts before requesting a draft.
Use placeholders for missing details and minimize personal information in prompts.
Have association counsel review notices, collection letters, and enforcement steps before use.
anti_patterns: Send generated notices without checking legal authority, delivery rules, and deadlines.
Invent violations, vote results, balances, or governing provisions to complete a document.
Treat a draft collection letter as authority to impose fines or record a lien.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports document drafting, and association counsel should review outputs before they are sent or recorded.

faq.question: Can it guarantee compliance with my state laws?
faq.answer: No. Supply current state requirements and association governing documents, then verify the draft with qualified counsel.

faq.question: Which documents can it help draft?
faq.answer: It covers meeting documents, budget worksheets, violation notices, collection letters, proxies, ballots, and architectural review forms.

faq.question: Does the folder include scripts or ready-made templates?
faq.answer: No. The supplied folder contains a public guide and excludes scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package.

faq.question: Can it send notices or collect payments?
faq.answer: No. The supplied guide describes drafting workflows, not delivery services, payment processing, or automated enforcement.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: The skill declares compatibility with SKILL.md-compatible agents. The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
